008package paint.shared.utils;

010import org.apache.commons.csv.CSVFormat;
011import org.apache.commons.csv.CSVParser;
012import org.apache.commons.csv.CSVPrinter;
013import org.apache.commons.csv.CSVRecord;
014
015import java.io.BufferedWriter;
016import java.io.IOException;
017import java.io.Reader;
018import java.nio.file.Files;
019import java.nio.file.Path;
020import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
021import java.util.ArrayList;
022import java.util.List;
023import java.util.Map;
024
025import static paint.shared.utils.BooleanUtils.isBooleanTrue;

027/**
028 * Utility class for common CSV file operations such as concatenation,
029 * record counting, and column modification.
030 * <p>
031 * This class is stateless and cannot be instantiated.
032 */
033public final class CsvUtils {
034
035    /**
036     * Prevents instantiation of this utility class.
037     */
038    private CsvUtils() {
039        // Prevent instantiation
040    }
041
042    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
043    // COUNTING UTILITIES
044    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
045
046    /**
047     * Counts the number of records in a CSV file where the column
048     * {@code "Process Flag"} has a value considered as {@code true}.
049     * <p>
050     * Accepted truthy values are: {@code "true"}, {@code "yes"}, {@code "y"},
051     * and {@code "1"} (case-insensitive).
052     *
053     * @param filePath path to the CSV file
054     * @return number of records marked as processed;
055     * returns {@code 0} if no valid "Process Flag" column is found
056     */
057    public static int countProcessed(Path filePath) {
058        int count = 0;
059
060        try {
061            CSVFormat format = CSVFormat.DEFAULT.builder()
062                                                .setHeader()
063                                                .setSkipHeaderRecord(true)
064                                                .build();
065
066            try (CSVParser parser = format.parse(TextFiles.newReader(filePath))) {
067
068                String processFlagKey = null;
069                for (String header : parser.getHeaderMap().keySet()) {
070                    if (header.trim().equalsIgnoreCase("Process Flag")) {
071                        processFlagKey = header;
072                        break;
073                    }
074                }
075
076                if (processFlagKey == null) {
077                    return 0;
078                }
079
080                for (CSVRecord record : parser) {
081                    String val = record.get(processFlagKey);
082                    if (isBooleanTrue(val)) {
083                        count++;
084                    }
085                }
086            }
087        } catch (IOException e) {
088            PaintLogger.errorf("CsvUtils.countProcessed() failed for %s: %s",
089                               filePath, e.getMessage());
090        }
091
092        return count;
093    }
094
095    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
096    // CONCATENATION UTILITIES
097    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
098
099    /**
100     * Concatenates multiple CSV files into a single CSV file, preserving headers.
101     * <p>
102     * The output file includes one header row (from the first valid input file)
103     * and all data rows from subsequent files. Optionally, the input files can be
104     * deleted after successful concatenation.
105     *
106     * @param inputFiles   list of input CSV file paths
107     * @param outputFile   target output file path
108     * @param deleteInputs if {@code true}, delete input files after processing
109     * @throws IOException if any I/O error occurs during reading or writing
110     */
111    public static void concatenateCsvFiles(List<Path> inputFiles,
112            Path outputFile,
113            boolean deleteInputs) throws IOException {
114
115        boolean headerWritten = false;
116        CSVPrinter printer = null;
117        List<Path> processed = new ArrayList<>();
118
119        try (BufferedWriter writer = Files.newBufferedWriter(outputFile)) {
120            for (Path inputFile : inputFiles) {
121                if (!Files.exists(inputFile)) {
122                    PaintLogger.warnf("Skipping missing file: %s", inputFile);
123                    continue;
124                }
125
126                try (Reader reader = TextFiles.newReader(inputFile);
127                     CSVParser parser = CSVFormat.DEFAULT.builder()
128                                                         .setHeader()
129                                                         .setSkipHeaderRecord(true)
130                                                         .build()
131                                                         .parse(reader)) {
132
133                    if (!headerWritten) {
134                        printer = new CSVPrinter(writer, CSVFormat.DEFAULT.builder()
135                                                                          .setHeader(parser.getHeaderMap().keySet().toArray(new String[0]))
136                                                                          .build());
137                        headerWritten = true;
138                    }
139
140                    for (CSVRecord record : parser) {
141                        printer.printRecord(record);
142                    }
143
144                    processed.add(inputFile);
145                }
146            }
147
148            if (printer != null) {
149                printer.flush();
150            }
151        }
152
153        if (deleteInputs) {
154            for (Path f : processed) {
155                try {
156                    Files.deleteIfExists(f);
157                } catch (IOException e) {
158                    PaintLogger.warnf("Could not delete %s: %s", f, e.getMessage());
159                }
160            }
161        }
162    }
163
164    /**
165     * Concatenates CSV files located in subdirectories of a given project path.
166     * <p>
167     * Each subdirectory corresponds to an experiment and contains a CSV file
168     * with the specified {@code fileName}. The resulting concatenated CSV file
169     * is written to the root project directory.
170     *
171     * @param projectPath     base directory containing experiment subdirectories
172     * @param fileName        CSV filename to concatenate from each subdirectory
173     * @param experimentNames list of experiment directory names
174     * @throws IOException if an I/O error occurs during processing
175     */
176    public static void concatenateNamedCsvFiles(Path projectPath,
177            String fileName,
178            List<String> experimentNames) throws IOException {
179        List<Path> inputs = new ArrayList<>();
180        for (String exp : experimentNames) {
181            inputs.add(projectPath.resolve(exp).resolve(fileName));
182        }
183
184        Path output = projectPath.resolve(fileName);
185        concatenateCsvFiles(inputs, output, false);
186    }
187
188    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
189    // CASE COLUMN UPDATER
190    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
191
192    /**
193     * Adds or updates a {@code "Case"} column in CSV files within the specified
194     * experiment subdirectories.
195     * <p>
196     * If the column exists, its values are overwritten. If not, it is appended
197     * to the end of the record. Each processed file is atomically replaced
198     * after writing the updated version.
199     *
200     * @param root            base path containing experiment subdirectories
201     * @param fileName        target CSV filename within each subdirectory
202     * @param experimentNames list of experiment subdirectory names
203     * @param caseName        value to assign to the "Case" column
204     * @throws IOException if an I/O error occurs during processing
205     */
206    public static void addCase(Path root,
207            String fileName,
208            List<String> experimentNames,
209            String caseName) throws IOException {
210
211        for (String exp : experimentNames) {
212            Path csvPath = root.resolve(exp).resolve(fileName);
213            if (!Files.exists(csvPath)) {
214                PaintLogger.warnf("CsvUtils.addCase(): file not found %s", csvPath);
215                continue;
216            }
217
218            Path tempPath = csvPath.resolveSibling(fileName + ".tmp");
219
220            CSVFormat readFormat = CSVFormat.DEFAULT.builder()
221                                                    .setHeader()
222                                                    .setSkipHeaderRecord(true)
223                                                    .build();
224
225            try (Reader reader = TextFiles.newReader(csvPath);
226                 CSVParser parser = new CSVParser(reader, readFormat);
227                 BufferedWriter writer = Files.newBufferedWriter(tempPath)) {
228
229                Map<String, Integer> headerMap = parser.getHeaderMap();
230                if (headerMap == null || headerMap.isEmpty()) {
231                    PaintLogger.warnf("CsvUtils.addCase(): missing or invalid header in %s", csvPath);
232                    continue;
233                }
234
235                boolean      hasCaseColumn = headerMap.containsKey("Case");
236                List<String> headers       = new ArrayList<>(headerMap.keySet());
237                if (!hasCaseColumn) {
238                    headers.add("Case");
239                }
240
241                // Define write format only once, now with explicit header
242                CSVFormat writeFormat = CSVFormat.DEFAULT.builder()
243                                                         .setHeader(headers.toArray(new String[0]))
244                                                         .build();
245
246                try (CSVPrinter printer = new CSVPrinter(writer, writeFormat)) {
247                    for (CSVRecord record : parser) {
248                        List<String> row = new ArrayList<>();
249                        for (String h : headerMap.keySet()) {
250                            if (h.equals("Case")) {
251                                row.add(caseName); // overwrite if exists
252                            } else {
253                                row.add(record.get(h));
254                            }
255                        }
256                        if (!hasCaseColumn) {
257                            row.add(caseName);
258                        }
259                        printer.printRecord(row);
260                    }
261                    printer.flush();
262                }
263
264                Files.move(tempPath, csvPath, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
265                PaintLogger.debugf("Updated 'Case' column in %s", csvPath);
266            }
267        }
268    }
269
270}
